question: In June 2025, which director turned cinema by converting toy-train coaches into a screening venue at Kurseong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishav Choudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2025**, the independent film director **Rishav Choudhary** gained significant attention for his innovative approach to cinema by converting heritage **toy-train coaches** into a specialized screening venue.
 
• This creative project was executed in **Kurseong**, a picturesque hill station located in the **Darjeeling** district of **West Bengal**, **India**.
 
• The initiative utilized the iconic coaches of the **Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR)**, transforming them into a mobile and stationary cinematic space to showcase regional and artistic films to both locals and tourists.
 
• The primary objective behind **Rishav Choudhary's** project was to promote **Himalayan cinema** and provide a unique cultural experience that merges the historical heritage of the railways with modern visual storytelling.
 
• This venue is considered the first of its kind in the **Eastern Himalayas**, marking a milestone in **cinema-tourism** within the region.
